variables.input:
timeseries x = max(software_inventory.programs.info, scalar:true), by:{program_publisher}
| fieldsAdd program_publisher = if(isNull(program_publisher) or program_publisher == "", "Unknown", else: program_publisher)
| dedup program_publisher
| fields program_publisher
| sort program_publisher asc

1.content:
## Software Inventory - Fleet Overview
Software distribution across all hosts reporting the Software Inventory extension. Use **Hostname**, **Publisher** and the **Software** search box (matches part of a program name, any case) to narrow the fleet. Data is the latest snapshot within the selected timeframe, so choose a timeframe longer than your collection interval.

2.title: Hosts reporting
2.query:
timeseries seen = max(software_inventory.programs.info, scalar:true), by:{host.name, program_name, program_version, program_publisher, install_date, install_location}
| fieldsAdd p = splitString(install_date, "/")
| fieldsAdd a = toString(p[0]), b = toString(p[1])
| fieldsAdd mo = if(toLong(a) > 12, b, else: a), dy = if(toLong(a) > 12, a, else: b)
| fieldsAdd install_date = if(arraySize(p) == 3, concat(p[2], "-", substring(concat("0", mo), from: stringLength(mo) - 1), "-", substring(concat("0", dy), from: stringLength(dy) - 1)), else: install_date)
| fieldsRemove p, a, b, mo, dy
| fieldsAdd program_publisher = if(isNull(program_publisher) or program_publisher == "", "Unknown", else: program_publisher), program_version = coalesce(program_version, "-"), install_location = coalesce(install_location, "-"), install_date = coalesce(install_date, "-")
| filter in(host.name, array($Hostname))
| filter in(program_publisher, array($Publisher))
| filter contains(program_name, $Software:triplequote, caseSensitive: false)
| summarize hosts = countDistinct(host.name)
